failures.description: smoke member failed: benchmark judge could not lease a Codex compute token (lease timeouts)
failures.evidence: Member test-mass-agent-run-0 (agent c7f8ba72, campaign ead67fb9, 11:28Z): failure_reason 'Compute token pool exhausted or cooling down: Declared evaluator t7-schema-task-complete execution failed: Codex compute token unavailable for agentic benchmark judge'. Worker log shows many 'Failed to fetch compute token: Activity task timed out' across the run's agents, i.e. the compute-token lease path timed out under load before the judge ran. The other 11 members passed, including both browser members that failed in the previous round and browser-biometrics-webdecoy. The diff touches no token leasing, judge or mass-agent code (run_benchmark.py judge fetch is unchanged from main at the merge base; main's later PR #1702 reworked it). Passed in 4 earlier rounds on the same agent code.
